moments.text: Phone video of a cream-coloured infrared screen, dark edge at left. Tick-marked crosshair, tiny dark dot near centre, small ring below-right, another at the bottom.
The phone shifts and the screen edge widens on the left; the second ring drops out of view, the first stays below-right of the crosshair.
The ring holds its place below-right of the crosshair centre; from about 15 s the second ring is back near the bottom right.

notes: Full-frame recheck: screen edge is visible from 0 s; added the tiny dot near centre.
